airportCountryOverride.reason: OurAirports files Mariehamn Airport (EFMA, IATA MHQ) under FI because it has no AX country row. EFMA is the airport of Mariehamn, Aland's capital; the generator requires the airport point to lie inside the exact Aland boundary (relation 1650407), so no Finnish mainland airport can be picked this way. Game venue map only; airport records do not establish current operations.
